note: What each candidate job provably does NOT read from the checkout
(ADR-0028, #1060 slice 3). This file inverted with that ADR: it used to be
an allow-list of what a job reads (#898), and is now a deny-list.
The default is therefore the whole checkout. A job's checkout axis is every
tracked path minus its `deny` entries, so a path nobody thought about is
in the key, and the only way to narrow a key is to write an entry here.
An entry is admissible only for a path the job reaches solely through its
artefact, or not at all (ADR-0028 section 6). A forgotten entry costs a
rerun; a wrong entry ships a stale result, which is the correctness bug the
allow-list version could produce by omission alone.
Syntax, unchanged from #898: `*` stops at a directory boundary, `**` crosses
it, `@name` expands the group below in place, and `!path` takes back what an
earlier entry in the same list matched -- so `docs/**` followed by
`!docs/installer-guarantees.md` denies the tree except that one file.
`definition` is the third axis and is never denied. Since #1546 it is per job:
a job's key hashes its own top-level block of .gitlab-ci.yml plus every block
it reaches through `*anchor` references and `extends:`, the global `default`,
`variables`, `workflow`, `stages` and `include` blocks (comments and blank
lines dropped), the scripts/ci/** files that text names (followed through
the scripts themselves), and the `definition` list below: the reuse
machinery, in every key, so a change to it invalidates all evidence at once.
`pipelineOwned` names the paths that axis owns. A job marked
`definitionCoversPipeline` reaches them only through its own definition, so
they leave its checkout axis and a change to one job's YAML reruns that job
and nothing else. `fast` and `fast_docker` are not marked:
their suites read the whole pipeline file and every ci script, so for them
those paths stay in the checkout axis and any CI edit still reruns them.
`artefact` names the thing under test whose identity the key also carries.
`image` means the image content ID build_image computes; a job with no
`artefact` is keyed on the source alone.
